papers.title: HiLS-Attention: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right
papers.what: A chunk-wise sparse attention that learns which chunks to read end-to-end under the language-modeling loss, matching full attention while extrapolating beyond 64x the training context length.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017); HARMamba (Li 2024)

papers.title: CLeaD: Layer-wise Cross-Lingual Depression Detection from Speech
papers.what: Aligns English and Mandarin WavLM speech embeddings into one clinical space for depression detection, and shows speaker leakage had inflated prior cross-lingual scores.
papers.builds_on: HeAR (Baur 2024); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025); LLMs Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023)

papers.title: SkillOpt-Lite: Agent Self-evolution via Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.what: Casts agent skill self-evolution as zeroth-order optimization with three justified steps, letting a small model with optimized skills pass a larger model on math and spreadsheet benchmarks.

papers.title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation (SenseNova-Vision)
papers.what: Poses detection, segmentation, depth, and pose as one generation problem inside a unified multimodal model, matching task-specialized systems without per-task heads.
